notes.title: November Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We've made some numerical adjustments to the last update's system and fixed several bugs:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where accumulating too much gold during battle could result in negative values.
[*]Added a condition to most features to mitigate the sporadic blockages that may arise from the use of time scale functions.
[*]Increased the diamond cost for global upgrades.
[*]Reduced the conversion ratio of gold to diamonds at the end of the game.
[*]Increased the difficulty level of Rage mode.
[/list]

I will continue to investigate any potential bugs in the game and add new content as planned. Thank you all for your patience and support during this time.

notes.title: Early November Update
notes.notes:
From community feedback, we've noticed that many players accumulate an excessive amount of external diamond currency during the later stages of the game with nowhere to spend or upgrade. Despite this, the in-game combat difficulty doesn't seem to alleviate. As a solution, we've implemented a global upgrade feature without any level or usage restrictions. This encompasses enhancements to the base health, stone damage boosts, and gold rewards upon the death of small creatures.

Additionally, we've resolved a majority of the reproducible bugs that have been reported over the past two weeks. This includes, but is not limited to, issues such as boomerangs not hitting shorter enemies, cows having excessive healing capabilities, and sporadic instances of monsters not dropping gold upon death.

We hope this update brings a more enjoyable, comfortable, and engaging gaming experience for all of you~

notes.title: October Update
notes.notes:
[i][h3]Hello, I'm developer. [/h3][/i]

After the stable version throughout the early october, most of the issues reported by players have been fixed. We have been continuously working on resolving these issues to ensure that everyone can enjoy the game with the repaired version ASAP. Due to this approach, we couldn't hold back and release a major update package all at once. Instead, we have been uploading updates while fixing them during the entire release week period. 

And now I will report to everyone about all the updates and fixes made during this time.

[h3]Fixed: [/h3]
[list]
 [*]In some situations, players encounter a bug where using a shovel to dig the ground turns the soil into stone.
 [*]When players have only one card in hand, there is a bug that causes incorrect card selection. 
 [*]Some turrets have calculation errors in their caused damage. 
 [*]Sometimes, in rage mode, there is a bug that leads to infinite spawning of monsters. 
 [*]The volume of certain sound effects is not affected by the settings. 
 [*]In rare cases, game stages are not influenced by player actions. 
 [*]When cows are healing, there is an issue where the healing amount overflows, preventing monsters from being killed. 
 [*]During island generation, there are occasional instances of significant differences in land height. 
 [*]Floating UI elements such as health bars and tower levels occasionally appear in the wrong places. 
 [*]There are some issues with saving and loading the upgrade UI on the main scene in certain situations. 
 [*]Multiple state checks have been added for different game stages to enhance game stability. 
 [*]A bug that caused incorrect value calculations during the settlement phase at the end of battles has been fixed.
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
 [*]Modified the timing of different stages in the game, so that the card pack pops up only after player interaction following the end of a battle. 
 [*]Reduced the battle preparation time from 10 seconds to 5 seconds. 
 [*]Redesigned the monster growth formula algorithm to create a smoother difficulty curve at the numerical level (however, the actual game difficulty will depend on the player's islands and strategy since it is linked to the number of monsters and entrance quantity per round). 
 [*]Optimized pathfinding logic and navmesh, reducing the performance impact of monster pathfinding and preparing for future items such as obstacles and traps. 
 [*]Increased the damage growth of certain defensive towers. 
 [*]Balanced the damage of certain defensive towers that were excessively unbalanced. 
 [*]Adjusted the overall game's earnings and made the game's earnings and peripheral upgrades more scientifically aligned.
 [*]Introduced a guaranteed card pool mechanism, so if players have not configured cards, upon entering the game, they will draw default cards of each type from the card pack instead of having no cards at all.
[/list]

[h3]New Additions:[/h3]
[list]
 [*]Added a question mark button on the battle interface, which, when clicked, will display several pages of videos. This provides a more direct way to teach new players how to play the game.
 [*]Added visual effects of tower levels, where higher-level towers will have larger sizes.
 [*]Added an easter egg on the main interface. If players stay on the main scene for a long time, the farmer character will slowly back to you:)
 [*]Implemented a default frame lock feature to save GPU processing power and electricity for players.
[/list]
 
These are the modifications and adjustments we have made to the version during this period. Now, let's talk about our future update plans:
[list]
 [*]Redesign the UI experience and improve the assets based on feedback from many players.
 [*]Design more defensive towers and crops from a mechanistic perspective, while also considering strengthening the agricultural gameplay by integrating farming content with the existing game mechanics.
 [*]Enhance differentiation between islands and deepen the strategic depth during the card selection phase.
 [*]Add Steam achievements and leaderboards.
 [*]Design and create a new tutorial for beginners.
 [*]Continuously optimize the version based on feedback and suggestions from players.
[/list]


If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to provide feedback in our game community. We sincerely appreciate everyone's understanding and support during this time!

Thank you again, and have a nice day (Bon jovi tone)

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce that the game has been live for three days now! First of all, we want to express our deepest gratitude for all the feedback and suggestions from our player community. We have been working around the clock to implement your valuable suggestions to enhance the gameplay experience.

During this period, we are focusing on the development of new content, including new monsters, defensive towers, and islands. Of course, if you have any feedback on the existing content, we will also continue to work on those in parallel. We hope to roll out new updates as soon as possible.

Here's a breakdown of what has been updated in this version:

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
 [*]Resolved the issue where rapid clicking during the card-drawing phase would result in multiple rewards.
 [*]Addressed the occasional glitch where cards would not correctly move into the hand area.
 [*]Fixed the issue where some monsters would hide in unreachable locations.
 [*]Added a double-check mechanism to ensure that small creatures are properly destroyed upon death.
 [*]Included a new feature for scene initialization that carries over player settings from other scenes.
 [*]Adjusted the minimum volume setting, allowing for complete muting of the background music.
 [*]Text corrections.
 [*]Added a queue system for opening treasure chests to avoid overlaps.
 [*]Players can now move freely while opening card packs.
 [*]Fixed interactions and card refund functions for the deconstructor.
 [*]Improved the counting of island entrances to avoid incorrect data that would significantly affect game difficulty.
 [*]Fine-tuned pathfinding parameters to reduce strange monster pathfinding behaviors.
 [*]Addressed the issue where the monster health bar would not disappear or would appear at odd 
 locations after the monster's death.
 [*]Minor fixes to various interaction animations and sound effects.
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments:[/h3]

[list]
 [*]Altered monster parameters, reducing their health but significantly increasing their numbers for more visual impact.
 [*]Increased the attributes of all defense towers, making their unique features more prominent.
 [*]Refined the battle result calculation rules to be more reasonable.
 [*]Again, significantly improved the attributes of the Boomerang.
 [*]Adjusted the healing formula for cows, reducing game difficulty in the later stages.
[/list]

[h3]Optimizations:[/h3]

[list]
 [*]Optimized floating UI update frequency and generation logic to reduce rendering and computation load.
 [*]Improved card UI layering.
 [*]Added asynchronous tile loading, reducing frame rate fluctuations.
 [*]Enhanced the basic global shader, adjusting light source computations.
 [*]Reduced the rendering cost of oceans.
[/list]

Thank you again for your continued support and feedback. If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out to us via community forums or other channels.

notes.title: [Regular Update] Enhanced Game Depth and Added More Interaction Support
notes.notes:
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
1. Fixed the issue where UI animations were affected by time scale.
2. Fixed the offset of the Boomerang's destination when upgrading a turret during its attack (although it's a bug, the effect is rather cool; it flies around the turret, killing all monsters within its range. We might design a new turret based on this mechanic).
3. Fixed the conflict that caused two card packs to open at once when the mouse was switched out (this fix will be moved to Berserk Mode after being tested for stability in the next version).
4. Fixed pathfinding issues for certain monsters.
5. Fixed the issue where the player would fall endlessly off the island under certain extreme conditions (we've also added a drowning animation for kicks).
6. Optimized the particle effects of the Comb, reducing rendering performance overhead.
7. Updated monster spawn frequency rules to prevent monsters from getting stuck.
8. Fully fixed SoleIsland generation and linking issues.

[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]
1. Lowered the Tomato Cannon's explosion damage multiplier: from 5 to 3.
2. Increased all small monsters' growth factor: from 1.5 to 2.
3. Increased all small monsters' base health multiplier: from 1.6 to 3.
4. Lowered the upgrade cost multiplier for all turrets: from 2 to 1.8.

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
1. New background music that changes according to the game phase, thanks to AudioJungle.
2. Improved mouse support, with two completely different sets of character interaction logic for keyboard/mouse and gamepad.
3. Added a camera distance switch; you can now adjust the game's camera distance using the mouse wheel.
4. Added numerous sound effects (for some sounds, we couldn’t find a suitable source, so we had to make them ourselves. Three hours of mouth popping in front of the mic and my mouth hurts).
5.Added palm tree—now trees can grow on your islands!

notes.title: [Major Update] Spice Up Your Battles with New Gameplay Diversity
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone! Since this is our first public announcement, allow me to introduce our game before diving into the update details.[/h1]

We initially designed this game to explore the potential of combining various gameplay elements that we thought were complementary. Although this "melting pot" approach might sound chaotic, we've been lucky to have enthusiastic testers from around the globe helping us refine it. We believe our game offers a promising framework for lots of fun and exploration.

To maintain transparency and keep the lines of communication open, we have a public Trello board that everyone is welcome to view and edit. We'll be actively monitoring Discord, Steam communities, and Trello, and promise to respond within 12 hours to any feedback or suggestions you might have.

By the way, we've kept our save files unencrypted. If a part of the game feels too tough, or you want a more relaxed experience, feel free to tweak the save files. We'll publish a guide on how to do that, or you can DM us the files on Discord for assistance.

[h1]And now, drum roll please... Here's what we've updated![/h1]

[h2]FIX[/h2]

    1. Fixed the invisible wall on the starting island, so no more accidental sea-dipping.
    2. Adjusted sound settings to introduce distance attenuation.
    3. Tweaked tower targeting rules—no more sniping critters miles away!
    4. Fine-tuned Tesla Tower crits.
    5. Addressed the Boomerang endpoint offset issues (yes, it was sneaking off).

[h2]ADJUST[/h2]

    1. Expanded the Tesla Tower's targeting range: 3 → 4.5
    2. Increased the Water Cannon's firing rate: 1.5 → 1
    3. Slowed down the Snake's movement speed: 2 → 1.5
    4. Reduced the upgrade cost multiplier for all towers: 2 → 1.8
    5. Slight adjustments to tech tree costs for towers.

[h2]ADD[/h2]

    1. Introducing the SoleIsland System! Islands will randomly spawn in the ocean at the start of the battle. Connect them to the mainland to activate sweet rewards!
    2. Activating a SoleIsland will grant you a defense tower, and the level of this tower will increase based on the rounds you've taken. In other words, a tower activated at turn 20 will have a much higher level than one activated at turn 1.
    3. Meet the Villagers! These absent-minded folks missed the last boat and it's up to you to save them. Rescued villagers will dash to safety, and you'll earn hefty rewards based on how many you save.
    4. Loot crops left behind by villagers.
    5. Five new islands with different paths and rewards.
    6. Freshly baked sound effects.


That wraps up our update! If you're keen on specific details or have any questions, hit us up! 🌟
